final: WITH g AS (SELECT P.ID AS pid, P.SEX AS sex, AVG(L.APTT) AS aptt, AVG(L.ALB - L.TP) AS d FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), s AS (SELECT sex, AVG(aptt) AS aptt, AVG(d) AS A FROM g GROUP BY sex), b AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM s) SELECT s.sex, s.aptt, s.A, s.A - b.B AS diff FROM s JOIN b ON b.B IS NOT NULL WHERE s.A > b.B
